basis: Official ileague data, rounds 1-4: goals, starts, approximate minutes, captaincy, suspensions.

players.name: ELVATEEH VARESIA AKHADA
players.why: Scored PERSIBA's first goal of the season (9', from outside the box at Persipa). Back from a two-yellow suspension.
players.why_id: Pencetak gol pertama PERSIBA musim ini (menit 9, tendangan dari luar kotak di kandang Persipa). Kembali setelah absen akumulasi kartu.

players.name: MUH ARSIL ANAS
players.why: 19 years old and already a starter: headed the 51' goal at Persipa, 3 starts + 1 sub appearance.
players.why_id: Baru 19 tahun tapi sudah jadi starter: sundulannya di menit 51 ke gawang Persipa, 3 kali starter + 1 kali masuk dari bangku cadangan.

players.name: AHMAD RIFAL
players.why: The constant in a back line that has changed every game: most minutes in the squad (about 315').
players.why_id: Satu-satunya yang konstan di lini belakang yang selalu berubah: menit bermain terbanyak di skuad (sekitar 315 menit).

players.name: USAMA AHMAD RAIHAN
players.why: Persibangga's main threat: 3 of their 4 goals (27', 32', 32'), all before half-time, every minute played.
players.why_id: Ancaman utama Persibangga: 3 dari 4 gol tim (menit 27, 32, 32), semuanya di babak pertama, main penuh di semua laga.

players.name: MUHAMMMAD ILHAMUL IRHAZ
players.why: Captain and midfield screen; back from a two-yellow suspension (booked by 41' and 45+2' in earlier games).
players.why_id: Kapten sekaligus gelandang bertahan; kembali dari akumulasi kartu (kartu kuning di menit 41 dan 45+2 pada laga sebelumnya).

players.name: ERLANGGA ADHYAKSA NUGRAHA
players.why: Played every minute (360'); captained the side at Gresik. The link between midfield and Usama.
players.why_id: Main penuh 360 menit; jadi kapten saat di Gresik. Penghubung lini tengah dengan Usama.

players.name: JOHAN YOGA UTAMA
players.why: 4 goals in 4 (2 penalties), joint top scorer in the league. Unbeaten Putra Sang Fajar lean on him.
players.why_id: 4 gol dari 4 laga (2 penalti), top skor bersama di liga. Putra Sang Fajar yang belum terkalahkan bertumpu padanya.

players.name: KOMARODIN
players.why: 2 goals, mostly off the bench: the 86' winner at Persinga and the only goal against Persibo.
players.why_id: 2 gol, kebanyakan dari bangku cadangan: gol kemenangan menit 86 di Ngawi dan satu-satunya gol melawan Persibo.

players.name: FIRMANSYAH
players.why: Captain, every minute played for the group leaders.
players.why_id: Kapten, main penuh di setiap laga untuk pemuncak grup.

players.name: MUHAMMAD FABIAN ASLAM
players.why: 3 goals from right-back, including the counter-attack winner in Bantul (29') and a brace against Persipa.
players.why_id: 3 gol dari posisi bek kanan, termasuk gol kemenangan lewat serangan balik di Bantul (menit 29) dan dua gol ke gawang Persipa.

players.name: FEBRIAN TRI YANTO
players.why: Goal against Persipa; 3 starts in midfield.
players.why_id: Mencetak gol ke gawang Persipa; 3 kali starter di lini tengah.

players.name: REXO DOLBY CALLEPSO
players.why: Late threat off the bench: the 90+3' equaliser at Gresik.
players.why_id: Ancaman di menit akhir dari bangku cadangan: gol penyeimbang menit 90+3 di Gresik.

players.name: SHAHIH ELANG RISHANDY
players.why: 2 goals after coming on at half-time against Persibangga (78' penalty, 90'). Gresik have scored all 4 goals after the break.
players.why_id: 2 gol setelah masuk di babak kedua melawan Persibangga (penalti menit 78 dan menit 90). Keempat gol Gresik lahir di babak kedua.

players.name: M. DZAKI ALAMSYAH
players.why: 88' equaliser at Persibo; another Gresik goal that came late.
players.why_id: Gol penyeimbang menit 88 di Bojonegoro; lagi-lagi gol telat dari Gresik.

players.name: ABDUL RAHMAN
players.why: Captain of a defence that has let in 3 in 4.
players.why_id: Kapten lini belakang yang hanya kebobolan 3 gol dari 4 laga.

players.name: MUCH ILHAM NOER
players.why: 2 goals (56', 67') from midfield; started every game.
players.why_id: 2 gol (menit 56 dan 67) dari lini tengah; selalu jadi starter.

players.name: ADITYA SENTOSA
players.why: Scored the winner in Bantul (29').
players.why_id: Pencetak gol kemenangan di Bantul (menit 29).

players.name: NANDA HELVRIT SAPUTRA
players.why: Captain, about 338' played.
players.why_id: Kapten, sekitar 338 menit bermain.

players.name: SEHABUDIN AHMAD
players.why: Scored at Persibangga; the starting striker.
players.why_id: Mencetak gol di kandang Persibangga; striker utama.

players.name: IQBAL TRI SAPUTRA
players.why: 79' goal against Gresik eight minutes after coming on.
players.why_id: Gol menit 79 ke gawang Gresik, delapan menit setelah masuk.

players.name: CRAH EKA ANGGER ISWANTO
players.why: Captain, every minute played (360').
players.why_id: Kapten, main penuh 360 menit.

players.name: DANHYL POETRA MARSELINHO TUKA
players.why: Both goals in the 2-2 with PERSIBA (15', 58').
players.why_id: Dua gol ke gawang PERSIBA di laga 2-2 (menit 15 dan 58).

players.name: AKHMAD RIYADI
players.why: Midfield anchor, about 337' played.
players.why_id: Jangkar lini tengah, sekitar 337 menit bermain.
